bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN p.media_kind='photo' AND p.media_file_id IS NOT NULL AND p.share_code=d.data->>'shareCode' THEN 'REGISTERED' WHEN d.data ? 'shareCode' THEN 'CODE_ONLY' WHEN d.data::text LIKE '%写真付きのリンク%' THEN 'BUTTON_READY' WHEN d.data ? 'media' THEN 'MEDIA_ONLY' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM public_post_drafts d LEFT JOIN link_button_posts p ON p.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND p.share_code=d.data->>'shareCode' WHERE d.module='link' AND d.data::text LIKE '%写真付きのリンク%' LIMIT 1;"
v="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$sql")" || exit 61
case "$v" in REGISTERED)exit 80;;CODE_ONLY)exit 81;;BUTTON_READY)exit 82;;MEDIA_ONLY)exit 83;;*)exit 84;;esac
